translations.web: For judgment is without mercy to him who has shown no mercy. Mercy triumphs over judgment.
translations.bsb: For judgment without mercy will be shown to anyone who has not been merciful. Mercy triumphs over judgment.
translations.kjv: For he shall have judgment without mercy, that hath shewed no mercy; and mercy rejoiceth against judgment.
translations.asv: For judgment is without mercy to him that hath showed no mercy: mercy glorieth against judgment.
